message.content:
**Signers of the U.S. Declaration of Independence**

| # | Name | State / Colony |
|---|------|----------------|
| 1 | **John Hancock** – *First* signer (his bold signature appears at top). | Massachusetts |
| 2 | Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| 3 | Josiah Bartlett | New Hampshire |
| 4 | William Hooper | North Carolina |
| 5 | Joseph Hewes | South Carolina |
| 6 | Stephen Hopkins | Rhode Island |
| 7 | Matthew Thornton | New Hampshire |

| 9 | Robert Morris | Pennsylvania |
|10 | George Clymer | Pennsylvania |
|11 | James Smith | Pennsylvania |
|12 | Richard Henry Lee | Virginia |
|13 | Francis Lightfoot Lee | Virginia |
|14 | Carter Braxton | Virginia |
|15 | Charles Thomson | Delaware |
|16 | Caesar Rodney | Delaware |
|17 | Thomas McKean | Delaware |
|18 | George Wythe | Virginia |
|19 | Peyton Randolph | Virginia |
|20 | Edmund Randolph | Virginia |
|21 | Patrick Henry | Virginia |
|22 | Edward Rutledge | South Carolina |
|23 | Thomas Stone | Maryland |
|24 | Frederick R. Vernon | Maryland |
|25 | Daniel Carroll | Maryland |
|26 | Roger Sherman | Connecticut |
|27 | Oliver Ellsworth | Connecticut |
|28 | William Floyd | New York |
|29 | Philip Livingston | New York |
|30 | Lewis Morris | New York |
|31 | William Paterson | New Jersey |
|32 | Jonathan Dayton | New Jersey |
|33 | Abraham Clark | New Jersey |
|34 | John Witherspoon | New Jersey |
|35 | William Williams | New York |
|36 | Alexander Hamilton | New York |
|37 | John Jay | New York |
|38 | John Hanson | Georgia |
|39 | George Walton | Georgia |
|40 | Button Gwinnett | Georgia |
|41 | Lyman Hall | Georgia |
|42 | George Washington | District of Columbia (though he did not sign) |

> **Note:**  
> - A total of **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies signed the Declaration when it was adopted on July 4, 1776.  
> - Some signatures appeared on copies made after the adoption (for example, those from the Southern states), so the above table lists only the individuals whose signatures appear on the official parchment preserved today.  

If you’d like a full alphabetical roster or details about each delegate’s background, let me know!
